svg.title: OpenHands/OpenHands: 36% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 36% of 471 recent commits in OpenHands/OpenHands carry a disclosed AI agent signature (newest 471 commits, since 2026-10-09). Claude Code 19%, OpenHands 17%, Devin 0.2%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
